name: Skin, blood flow & cold

chart.xLabel: minutes making snowballs (after the first five)

overlay.caption: cold shuts finger blood vessels → after a while they reopen in bursts → red, hot-feeling fingers

does: Shows cold first closing down blood flow to bare fingers (they go pale)
Shows the body reopening finger blood vessels after several minutes to send warm blood
Shows that the colder it is, the stronger both effects are
doesnt: Measure any real person — the numbers are illustrative teaching values
Show the on-and-off waves of reopening; it shows the average
Model dangerous cold — the reopening only protects for a while
limits.text: This is a simplified learning model. Real people vary with age, fitness and health. The numbers are illustrative, not measurements of any real person.
limits.wellbeing: Fingers that stay white, numb or hard in the cold are a reason to go inside and tell an adult right away.

sources: CK-12 Life Science: integumentary system and thermoregulation
Any high-school physiology text: cold-induced vasodilation ('hunting reaction')
